unresolved: Whether premium/imported DesignPattern markup (html/css/js) is intended to be readable/previewable by every authenticated account; frontend shows all designs but backend selection is plan-gated.
Whether the global user throttle (1000/day) is sufficient for the per-request preview render; requires benchmarking and production capacity data.

StoreCustomization.template/template_draft are CharField(max_length=12) while DesignPattern.slug allows 120 chars; pattern slugs longer than 12 chars would pass the existence check but cannot be persisted. Functional mismatch, not a security finding.
Actual deployment behavior of proxies, Redis cache, and throttle fail-open cannot be confirmed from source alone.

checks.invariant: public plan catalog exposes only intended marketing fields, no write surface
checks.result: pass: GET /api/plans/ AllowAny read-only by construction (GenericViewSet list/retrieve only); PlanCatalogSerializer exposes public fields + computed benefits; fixed ordering; page_size<=200; is_trial intentionally public for legacy benefit resolution but excluded from selection paths.

checks.invariant: no accidental write exposure on public catalog
checks.result: pass: no create/update/destroy methods or config keys; serializer fields read_only or SerializerMethodField.

checks.invariant: design catalog writes staff-only, reads active-only for non-staff
checks.result: pass: get_permissions AllowAny only for 'default', IsAdminUser for writes, IsAuthenticated otherwise; non-staff queryset is_active=True; serializers constrain code fields CODE_MAX, tokens<=80 keys, clean_style_effects/variables/icon_set; tests confirm anon 401, owner write 403.

checks.invariant: pattern retrieve/preview gated by plan entitlement like selection
checks.result: partial: retrieve uses DesignPatternSerializer incl html/css/js; preview returns rendered html/css + raw pattern.js; both reachable by ANY authenticated account — no tier/benefit check vs allowed_templates_of. Frontend designApi.pattern(slug) has no call sites (uses listPatterns + patternPreview).

checks.invariant: preview render cost bounded by dedicated throttle or cache
checks.result: partial: preview inherits ResilientUserRateThrottle 1000/day; no dedicated scope or cache; single-request bounded by CODE_MAX=200k per field; PublicReadThrottle is NOT dead here (custom get_cache_key pinned-IP per action).

checks.invariant: store design selection owner-scoped and plan-gated at write/publish/restore/render
checks.result: pass: owner-scoped get_object_or_404, has_customization on writes, allowed_templates_of filter on template fields, publish/restore re-check, render_store_pattern re-checks stored template vs current plan with default fallback. Tests cover restore isolation.
pass: customization resolved from request.user; StudioVersion restore scoped (store,version_id) 404 foreign; public render resolves by slug with own benefits.

checks.invariant: pattern markup sanitized before serving as document/preview/srcdoc
checks.result: pass: sanitize_markup strips scripts/handlers/dangerous URLs; sanitize_css blocks </style breakout; render escapes non-list vars; preview iframe sandbox no allow-same-origin; public document nonce CSP + XFO SAMEORIGIN. Residual: preview 'accent' only requires '#' prefix (not full hex validation); preview 'style' lookup doesn't filter is_active.

checks.invariant: public design catalog bounded and cache-consistent
checks.result: pass: AllowAny+PublicReadThrottle, active-only, epoch-keyed 300s cache, signals bump epoch on save/delete, filters limited, page_size<=200.
